block.isekai_mahou.mana_core.tooltip1: Click: deposit/withdraw mana. Sneak + empty hand: pour in all your mana.
block.isekai_mahou.mana_core.tooltip2: Pedestals and Condensers linked with a Mana Conductor use this mana wirelessly.
block.isekai_mahou.mana_core.tooltip3: Withdrawing past your max = overcharge (dangerous!). Keeps its charge when broken.
item.isekai_mahou.mana_conductor.unbound: Not tuned: click a Mana Core.
item.isekai_mahou.mana_conductor.tooltip: Click a Core: tune the Conductor to it.
Click a Pedestal or Condenser: link it to the Core (again: unlink).
Sneak + click a Pedestal: switch it on/off.
Click the air: show links. Sneak in the air: clear the tuning.
item.isekai_mahou.mana_conductor.range: Range: %s blocks, same world. Every %s blocks of distance add +%s%% mana per cast.
effect.isekai_mahou.mana_intoxication.de: Too much mana in the body: periodic magic damage down to 1 health (never kills, but then any hit will). Every 300 overcharge = 1 level; level VI and up also cause nausea. Milk does not cure it: spend the overcharge, deposit it in a Core or wait for it to bleed away.
message.isekai_mahou.mana_core.no_player: You have no mana to deposit.
message.isekai_mahou.mana_core.not_owner: Only %s (the owner) can withdraw from this Core.
message.isekai_mahou.mana_core.over_cap: Overcharge at its limit (%s): your body can't hold more mana!
message.isekai_mahou.mana_core.withdrew_: Withdrew %s mana — %s above your limit! Overcharge: %s (Intoxication level %s)
message.isekai_mahou.mana_core.intoxicat: Mana Intoxication level %s! Spend the overcharge or deposit it in a Core.
message.isekai_mahou.mana_core.conductor: Conductor tuned to the Core at %s, %s, %s (%s / %s mana)
Tune the Conductor first: click a Mana Core.
The tuned Core is in another world.
Too far from the Core: %s blocks (max %s).
The tuned Core no longer exists.
The tuned Core is too far away (chunk not loaded).
message.isekai_mahou.mana_core.linked: Linked to the Core! %s blocks · +%s%% mana per cast
command.isekai_mahou.mana_core.given: You received a Mana Core and a Mana Conductor.
command.isekai_mahou.mana_core.look_at_c: Look at a Mana Core (within 8 blocks).
gui.isekai_mahou.pedestal.toggle.tooltip: Switch this pedestal on/off (off = no casting, no mana spent). Also: sneak + click it with a Mana Conductor.
gui.isekai_mahou.pedestal.scroll.tooltip: Place a Spell Scroll (write the spell in the Grimoire).
gui.isekai_mahou.pedestal.filter.tooltip: Place 1 item as a choice for the pedestal glyphs: e.g. the seed that Sow will plant. Glyphs that don't use a filter ignore it.
gui.isekai_mahou.pedestal.core.tooltip.o: Linked to a Mana Core %s blocks away: pays from it first (+%s%% transmission). If it lacks enough mana, uses the batteries.
gui.isekai_mahou.pedestal.core.tooltip.u: The linked Core's chunk is not loaded: using the batteries only.
gui.isekai_mahou.pedestal.core.tooltip.m: The linked Core no longer exists. Link again with a Mana Conductor.
gui.isekai_mahou.pedestal.core.tooltip.f: The linked Core is too far away (max %s blocks).
gui.isekai_mahou.pedestal.core.tooltip.n: Use a Mana Conductor to link this pedestal to a Mana Core (up to %s blocks, wireless).
gui.isekai_mahou.pedestal.hint.switched_: Turn it on with the button or the Conductor (sneaking).
gui.isekai_mahou.pedestal.hint.waiting_c: The trigger hasn't happened yet; checks again next interval.
gui.isekai_mahou.pedestal.hint.no_source: Place a Battery within %2$s blocks or link a Core.
gui.isekai_mahou.pedestal.hint.no_mana_c: Fill the Batteries or the Mana Core.
gui.isekai_mahou.mana_core.stats.idle: No tower used mana in the last minute.
gui.isekai_mahou.mana_core.core.tooltip: Core reserve. Pedestals and Condensers linked with a Mana Conductor (up to %s blocks) draw/fill it wirelessly; every %s blocks of distance add +%s%% per cast.
gui.isekai_mahou.mana_core.you.tooltip: Your mana. Anything you withdraw above your max becomes OVERCHARGE.
gui.isekai_mahou.mana_core.you.over: Overcharge: %s (Intoxication level %s). Spent first; slowly bleeds away on its own.
gui.isekai_mahou.mana_core.deposit.toolt: Puts your mana into the Core. Overcharge goes first (the safe way to get rid of it).
gui.isekai_mahou.mana_core.deposit.all.t: Pours all your mana (and overcharge) into the Core. Shortcut: sneak + click the Core with an empty hand.
gui.isekai_mahou.mana_core.withdraw.tool: Takes mana from the Core. Anything past your max becomes OVERCHARGE (every %s = 1 level of Mana Intoxication).
gui.isekai_mahou.mana_core.withdraw.fill: Takes only what you need to fill your mana. Safe.
gui.isekai_mahou.mana_core.withdraw.over: Fills your mana and takes %s more as overcharge: +1 level of Mana Intoxication (damage down to 1 health)!
gui.isekai_mahou.mana_core.withdraw.deni: Only the Core's owner can withdraw.
gui.isekai_mahou.mana_core.hint: ⚠ Above your max: every %s overcharge = 1 Intoxication level.
gui.isekai_mahou.mana_core.hint2: Intoxication hurts down to 1 health: it won't kill, but any hit will.
